about: Making groups, their marks, and opening their invitations (spec/sync-protocol.md, Groups). guessMark: the mark グループを作る offers from the name as it is typed, until one is picked: the emoji of the first of design's groupMarkHints with a word anywhere in the name, else the name's first character as a reader sees it, trimmed, in the `color` slot nextGroupColor gives, else groupMarkFallbackLetter for a name with none. `expected` names the mark's one kind, `emoji`, or `letter` with its `color`. openedInviteCode: the invitation code a link opening the app carries, the site's アプリで開く (pochical://invite/{code}, scheme and host in any case, a trailing / allowed) or one of Pochical's own invitation links as chat-text.json's inviteCode reads them; null for any other link, or a code not of inviteRules.codeLength characters of inviteRules.codeAlphabet (design/src/invite.ts). nextGroupColor: the color a group's icon or letters start in, from the `marks` of the user's other groups: as a new pattern's (patterns.json, nextColor), counting only the marks drawn in a color, an icon or letters; an emoji's or a photo's color is 0 on the wire and is no color.

guessMark.name: a word anywhere in the name
no hint: the first letter in the free color
the first character as a reader sees it
a name with no letter yet

nextGroupColor.name: an emoji and a photo use no color
the first color an icon or letters leave free
every color used: the colored groups' count modulo the palette
